This is a shutdown request. To approve
it, call SendMessage with exactly 
this input, where "message" is a JSON 
object rather than a string: 
{"to":"team-lead","message":{"type":"s
hutdown_response","request_id":"shutdo
wn-1790092571859@r7-device-tier-and-ad
aptive-quality","approve":true}}. 
Approving ends your process; a 
plain-text acknowledgment does not 
shut you down. To decline, for example
because you're mid-task, send the 
same input with "approve": false and a
"reason".
